beats.text: TCS and Infosys plan to bring in around forty-five thousand freshers. So why did India's top five IT firms add just sixteen thousand people in six months?
TCS made about twenty-five thousand fresher offers for this year.
Infosys is targeting around twenty thousand, and hired over eight thousand last quarter alone.
But across the top five firms, total headcount grew by just sixteen thousand fifty-five from April to September.
Think of a bucket with a hole: freshers pour in, but people leave almost as fast.
And companies say demand is still weak.
So the door is open — but it's a revolving door.
Getting in is step one. AI and cloud skills decide who stays.
